methodology: Generator4 matched circulation experiments: four seeds, two pricing modes, idle/managed, four fiscal arms (64 rules1 worlds) plus16 diagnostic rules0 controls, all on the same modern generated geography and configuration. Merchant charter, Ascension0, Sandbox,365days. Fiscal arms share initial finite goods and accounts; no old four-town generation mode is retained. Managed facilities resolve canonical recipe eligibility, enforcing local producer/consumer separation. Every command audits money, physical goods, fees and FIFO; same-world reverse enumeration, culture replay and exact save continuation are checked. No Mint, external contracts, hidden inventory, subsidies or outcome-driven repair. Compact format4 preserves actual town-level economic checkpoints. Numeric goods/coins are raw1/10000; quotes are hypothetical current-state proposals, never remote trade permission. Positive value or food consumption does not establish indefinite sustainability.
managedPolicy: At day0 pay for Farm, Mill, Bakery and Lumber Camp in their first ordinal eligible towns. Each input producer is separate from its direct consumer. Farm and Camp sell outputs; Mill buys Grain(target8,max24) and sells Flour(min6); Bakery buys Flour(target2,max30) and Logs(target3,max18) and sells Bread(min1). Actual warehouse rules combine safely if compatible facilities share a town. Reserves100coins except Mill80. Enable factories only with cash>=120 and public output below Grain24/Flour12/Bread24/Logs12. Physically position the Merchant at Mill, then ship up to4 Flour(min1,max22) into the Bakery warehouse and return up to4 Bread(min1,max50) to the Mill market. Route reserve100, empty returns allowed. No extra vessels or direct state assignments; finite stocks and purchasing power may stall this policy.
